dct_title_s: Suggestive plan for the acquisition and improvement of Rice Lake and Minnehaha Creek, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan showing suggestions for the acquisition and improvement of Rice Lake and Minnehaha Creek in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirty-second Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 24.
